skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK to a single target, 100% chance to cause the target to [Collapse] for 2 rounds (decreases DMG Free by 20%).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 350% ATK. The last strike has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on the main target for 2 rounds (decreases DMG Rate by 10%, deals 200% ATK of [Collapse] DMG when attacked, stacks up to 3 times, does not stack with [Collapse]).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Grants himself 50% Non-Crit DMG Free (effective against all types of DMG, cannot co-exist with [Agility]), lasting 4 rounds.After receiving fatal DMG, revives with 50% max HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Non-Crit DMG Free duration 4 rounds → 5 roundsRevive HP 50% → 100%

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, decrease all enemies ATK by 30%, obtains 20% Drain Rate, lasts for 2 rounds. Before any character acts, launches [Ultimate Follow-up] (60% DMG and 100% effect), once per round.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Decrease enemies ATK 30% > 40% Obtains 20% Collapse Rate Drain Rate 20% > 30% Follow-up DMG 60% > 100%

effects.desc: Evasion type buff; mutually exclusive with Non-Crit Damage Immunity.
